description:
Fast voice dictation for your desktop

Spokenly turns speech into text in any application: press the dictation shortcut, speak, and the words are typed for you. Supports local and cloud transcription models, 50+ languages, file transcription, and a searchable dictation history.
• Added MAI-Transcribe 2 with language, keyterm, and transcript cleanup settings
• Added live English dictation with Cartesia ink-2 using your own API key
• Added an optional language field to OpenAI-compatible providers
• Fixed the file transcription progress bar freezing on long Whisper runs
• Various bug fixes and stability improvements
